def contrastive_ordinal_loss(embeddings, depths, margins_module, strategies=None):
    """
    Multi-margin contrastive ordinal loss (vectorized).

    For each anchor i with depth d_i, computes:
        L_i = mean_{j: d_j != d_i} max(0, M(d_i, d_j) + sim(i, j) - mean_pos_sim(i))

    where mean_pos_sim(i) = mean cosine similarity to same-depth samples.
    M(d_i, d_j) is the effective learnable margin, monotonically increasing with |d_i - d_j|.

    All operations are differentiable through the margin parameters.
    """
    B = embeddings.size(0)
    device = embeddings.device

    if B < 2:
        return torch.tensor(0.0, device=device, requires_grad=True)

    sim = torch.matmul(embeddings, embeddings.t())  # (B, B)

    eye = torch.eye(B, dtype=torch.bool, device=device)
    same_depth = (depths.unsqueeze(1) == depths.unsqueeze(0)) & ~eye
    diff_depth = depths.unsqueeze(1) != depths.unsqueeze(0)

    valid = same_depth.any(dim=1) & diff_depth.any(dim=1)
    if not valid.any():
        return torch.tensor(0.0, device=device, requires_grad=True)

    same_f = same_depth.float()
    pos_sim = (sim * same_f).sum(dim=1) / same_f.sum(dim=1).clamp(min=1)  # (B,)

            device=device,
